description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Myr Turbine's first ability by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
The Myr enters the battlefield, triggering Symmetry Matrix, causing you to pay {1} to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding two cards, untapping Myr Turbine and the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.
